question: Should maintainers accept this PR as the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99712 after resolving the release-owned changelog handling?
rationale: The implementation is a plausible best-layer bug fix, but it changes message-delivery terminal semantics and the PR carries a protected maintainer label plus a release-owned changelog edit.

options.title: Accept after changelog handling
options.body: Treat this as the canonical fix, remove or explicitly own the changelog entry through the release path, and merge after exact-head required checks remain acceptable.

options.title: Ask for fresh Telegram proof
options.body: Request a new native Telegram/Desktop proof if maintainers want transport-visible confirmation beyond the exact-head proof check and TUI/Gateway coverage.

options.title: Use another candidate PR
options.body: Pause this PR only if maintainers decide a different linked candidate should own the same empty-interactive-reply fix.

recommendation.title: Accept after changelog handling
recommendation.body: Treat this as the canonical fix, remove or explicitly own the changelog entry through the release path, and merge after exact-head required checks remain acceptable.
